plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Live ADS-B (1090 MHz) air traffic tracking via dump1090 -- aircraft table plus a live map
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Generic nearby-BLE-device radar: Start/Stop scan, live sortable table of every advertising Bluetooth LE device in range (address, name, vendor, RSSI, last seen), with manufacturer, services and address type per device from an offline vendor database.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: DAB/DAB+ digital radio via welle-cli -- channel scan, live tuning/playback, and per-channel display names
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: DAPNET/POCSAG amateur-radio paging via a companion board (pocsag_companion) over USB serial -- Recent Pages, Capcodes, Send, and Settings tabs, plus its own capture source and protocol registered with the core pipeline
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Minimal example plugin: a top-level sidebar page that just says hello. Reference for the sidebar-page seam -- see docs/PLUGINS.md.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Minimal example plugin: injects a message into the Hello World page instead of owning a page of its own. Reference for the hook seam -- see docs/PLUGINS.md.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Download OpenStreetMap tiles for offline use. Builds and manages Cyclenerd/offline-map-tile-downloader (vendored at offline-map-src/) as a subprocess with its own web UI for picking a download area.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Drives a small I2C status OLED (SSD1306-family) with a boot logo then live device status -- IP address, which capture sources are actually running, uptime. Auto-blanks after a configurable timeout to avoid burn-in. Settings page shows a live preview of exactly what's on the physical screen.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Dutch emergency dispatch (P2000, FLEX on 169.65 MHz) decoding via rtl_fm + multimon-ng
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: POCSAG512/1200/2400 pager decoding on 172.45 MHz via rtl_fm + multimon-ng
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: POCSAG512/1200/2400 pager decoding on 439.9875 MHz via rtl_fm + multimon-ng
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: FM/AM/SSB broadcast & utility radio listener via rtl_fm + ffmpeg, with RDS on FM via redsea -- Digital and Analogue display skins, a preset stations picker, and a Web Audio VU meter
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Scan for WiFi networks and switch the Pi's WiFi connection from the dashboard -- no shell needed. A Network tab shows the wired (eth0) connection's own status alongside it. Uses NetworkManager (nmcli), already installed on Bookworm-era Raspberry Pi OS. Read-only status is always available; scanning and connecting are admin-only.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Native Reticulum/LXMF messaging -- meshpoint's own LXMF delivery destination on the local rnsd shared instance, the peer roster built from announces, the Reticulum page (Peers/Messages/Send/Settings) and a compact topbar pill.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: A full multi-tab NomadNet browser for Reticulum -- tabs, address bar, back/forward/reload, favourites (shared with the Reticulum page's own Browse tab and the Reticulum Dashboard's quick-browse modal), a raw/rendered view toggle, and keyboard shortcuts. Feature set inspired by fr33n0w's rBrowser (see homepage); this is a clean-room implementation for Meshpoint's own plugin architecture, not a code port -- full credit in README.md. Requires the reticulum plugin enabled.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Voice calls over Reticulum -- a Call tab on the Reticulum page, Codec2 encoded, browser to browser. Backend byte-pipe lives in the reticulum plugin itself (same RNS identity as LXMF delivery); this plugin is the call UI + Codec2 WASM only.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: A live, standalone view of Reticulum activity -- stat cards, a telemetry map of located peers, a live peer list, and a flashing real-time announce ticker. Companion to the reticulum plugin's own Peers/Messages/Settings page; requires reticulum enabled to show data.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: Generic RTL-SDR OOK/FSK decoder (rtl_433) -- weather stations, TPMS, remote sensors, and hundreds of other 433/315/868 MHz devices
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC

plugins.description: The RTL-SDR host page -- every RTL-SDR plugin (Radio, DAB+, P2000, Pagers, POCSAG, RTL433, ADS-B, ACARS) hooks its own tab into this page via the 'hook' seam instead of owning a page of its own.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC
